profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorganChase | Former Amazon SDE | Former Twitch SDE
profile.summary:
"Hey programmers!" My name is Quynn and I love to code. Simple as that. My ongoing journey began with writing my first lines of HTML and CSS code. I couldn't believe all the power I could wield from just constructing HTML tables and turning the background color blue. My curiosity was piqued so I began to learn JavaScript as my first language. 

I'm currently looking to integrate my skills with the innovation of AI.

Programming has opened up a new, exciting, and creative world for me to explore, and I genuinely feel lucky to have stumbled upon it. So, lets all devour more coding knowledge and pay it forward in technological advancements for the future together. Happy coding!

positions.title: Bartender / Barback
positions.description:
- Balanced several tasks in a high pace, high volume, chaotic environment to produce greater output in a shorter duration of time to improve customer experience. 
- Maintained personal cash drawers counted every other hour to pinpoint and reduce money shortages.

company.name: Ye Olde Cock N’ Bull Tavern

positions.title: Pharmacy Intern / Technician
positions.description:
- Counseled patients to adhere to proper medication therapy management practices to boost comprehension and regimen coherence to improve overall health. 
- Leveraged data entry shorthand to increase prescription output and reduce overall wait times for patients. 
- Collaborated with patients’ insurance companies and discount programs to verify coverage and reduce patient copay amounts. 
- Provided utmost highest quality customer service to ensure patients have  a calm and less abrasive experience.

positions.title: Pharmacy Intern / Technician
positions.description:
- Reordered shelved inventory weekly to track accurate quantities and  improve efficiency to meet and exceed hourly prescription quotas. 
- Compiled inventory quantities, ordered stock, and checked-in daily medication deliveries.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
- Provided resources for students to explore their collegiate curiosity to join campus organizations, events, and local community service. 
- Organized safe space social hangouts for residents to break out their comfort zone and upgrade their interpersonal skills. 
- Crafted monthly informational and creative themed billboards to inspire and incite individual expression.
